name: manta-glamsterdam-relay-guard
description: Glamsterdam OptimismPortal relay guard: local tests, fork test and deployment script

scripts.plan: for n in manta-mainnet manta-sepolia; do forge script script/UpgradePortal.s.sol --sig 'plan(string)' $n; done && git diff --exit-code -- deploy/out
scripts.test:fork:mainnet: NETWORK=manta-mainnet FORK_RPC_URL=$MAINNET_RPC_URL forge test --match-contract UpgradeFork -vv --evm-version osaka
scripts.test:fork:sepolia: NETWORK=manta-sepolia FORK_RPC_URL=$SEPOLIA_RPC_URL forge test --match-contract UpgradeFork -vv --evm-version amsterdam
